NB: This flow is controlled by the COE. Do not make any changes without the prior approval from the Service Cloud Leads at the COE. Any unauthorised changes will be overridden by the master copy of the flow.
SFP-5802 - This flow triggers a screen to allow consultants to capture cases manually.
Update: - Created a variable to store the value to identify if flow is called from new manual button or CTI - SFP-19027- Create and Resolve a case: added Component Visibility filters for "Create and Resolve The Case" and "Account Does Not Exist" checkboxes, controlled by RM_South_Africa_Permission_set -SFP-19801 - add cases from Insurance Policy and Claim handling path 11 Aug 2023: Removed IsWIUser -SFP-28511 - Complaints Management MVP 1 (Base Functionality) | Flow Changes 16 Aug 2023: Added W&I logic 23 Feb 2024 - SFP-35986 - Disable Create & Resolve for SA Wealth & Investment Teams. Temporary workaround, Improved Framework will be incorporated soon. -SFP-21373 - Queries Management Additional Product Information - hardcoded email template logic for Complaints Management was changed to read it from the team
26 Apr 2024 DM - Resolution Comments to Client field added to "Create And Resolve Case" section, and added value assignment to "Create New Case and Resolve" step.
06 June 2024 SFP-35732 SFP-35734 Dynamically populate the picklist values of the queue names in the user screen based on which country is the used assigned to. SFP-44420 - PPB SA Complaints: Notification to banker
SFP-35988 - Complaints Management - SMS functionality SFP-38372 - Additional Fields for Client Experience Service Type SFP-56611 - Enable Fraud Reference Capture for Fraud Cases
